items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: And this Nelson, he was with Sidney Duesley Band at the time

ctx.x: What did you like about Marrero? I mean you took over, I mean you saw him quite a bit, I gather, down here. What about his playing did you like? I've never saw him.

Well the whole band itself, my daddy was very rich and my daddy were very good friends, and also some other things. I don't know what's happening. John, no, that's how this happened. Well I used to listen to that fellow, young fellow, you'd go to dances and things like that, and listen to that, the fellow's playing. And they had another fellow named Cap of Daringberg who played on the roof garden after John Grabber and we, I still call it, I don't know what they call it, something else, the building is still…
You said you would have never thought about playing banjo?
